# tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeeds (Data Source)

dedicated changefeeds data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeeds" "example" {
  cluster_id = "your_cluster_id"
}

output "output" {
  value = data.tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeeds.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster.

### Optional

- `downstream_type` (String) The downstream type to filter by. If specified, only changefeeds of the specified downstream type will be returned. Available values: `KAFKA`, `MYSQL`, `S3`, `GCS`, `AZURE_BLOB`.

### Read-Only

- `changefeeds` (Attributes List) The changefeeds. Use the `tidbcloud_dedicated_changefeed` data source to read the full configuration of a single changefeed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--changefeeds))

<a id="nestedatt--changefeeds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `changefeeds`

Read-Only:

- `changefeed_id` (String) The ID of the changefeed.
- `checkpoint_ts` (String) The checkpoint timestamp of the changefeed.
- `checkpoint_tso` (String) The checkpoint TSO of the changefeed.
- `create_time` (String) The creation time of the changefeed.
- `downstream_type` (String) The downstream type of the changefeed.
- `error` (String) The error message when the changefeed is in the `FAILED` or `ERROR` state.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the changefeed.
- `replication_capacity` (String) The replication capacity (RCU) of the changefeed.
- `state` (String) The current state of the changefeed.
